rules: development (Office/dynamic/Capture_1): existing Stage 1-4 and Step 8 outputs; code is developed and checked here.
adjustment (Office/dynamic/Capture_2): the only capture on which any parameter may be adjusted.
final_evaluation (Office/dynamic/Capture_3, Capture_4): untouched until one final evaluation with a frozen config.
cross_scene_final_evaluation (Gym/dynamic Captures 2-6): untouched cross-scene test, final evaluation only.
excluded (Gym/dynamic/Capture_1): prior use in the Stage 3 depth test, so it is not an untouched test capture; excluded from every evaluation split.
Scripts refuse captures in final_evaluation_splits unless --final-evaluation is passed, and always refuse captures in excluded_splits, even with --final-evaluation (data_splits.guard).
Exclusions take precedence over every other entry regardless of their order in captures (data_splits.split_of).

recorded.Gym/dynamic cross-scene split: 2026-10-13, before any Capture_2 use and before the motion config was frozen

prior_use.Synthetic_Scenes/Office/dynamic/Capture_: Stage 1-4 and Step 8 development runs; Stage 3 fit of depth far plane and vertical FOV against reference 3D boxes.
prior_use.Synthetic_Scenes/Gym/dynamic/Capture_1: Stage 3 held-out depth/intrinsics test only (validate_depth.py: reference instance masks vs reference 3D boxes). No model, fusion or motion output was produced and nothing was fitted on it. Its RGB frames and people were never processed.
